hypothesis: One scalar Elo rating cannot distinguish opponent-adjusted scoring and prevention strength, which may limit probability and margin accuracy.
selection_rule: On 2010-2022 chronological predictions only: lowest calibrated log loss, then Brier, margin RMSE, lower update rate, and higher offseason retention.

evaluation.disposition: Prefer scalar Elo unless the candidate is directionally stable against the unchanged reference, beats calibrated scalar Elo on probability metrics, beats bounded-margin Elo on margin metrics, and later demonstrates material value. No threshold is invented in this bounded run.

post_result_uncertainty_diagnostic.method: paired game-level percentile bootstrap on common support
post_result_uncertainty_diagnostic.honesty: Added after the first development result was inspected; diagnostic only, never predeclared protected evidence.

missingness: Team offense and defense states initialize to zero deviations with explicit games-observed and information-scarcity values; no absent factual score is imputed.
pit_policy: All game updates occur only after the complete season-type/week batch is predicted. Report seasons never select parameters.
